name: event-countdown-clock
title: Event Countdown Clock
description: A T− clock in four cells (days, hours, minutes, seconds) in a hairline panel under a title that wipes in. The days and hours race down, the last five seconds tick in real time with a ten-segment bar emptying each second, then the clock turns to the accent colour, flips to T+, and a short "now" line takes the title's place.
useWhen: A launch, shop opening, premiere or graduation with a known moment to build up to.
The video should end on the moment itself ("Kami buka sekarang!").
avoidWhen: A sale deadline stated as a date: use flash-sale-burst, it stays true whenever watched.
A real-time countdown longer than a few seconds: this one races the days and hours as a time-lapse.
author: Mosio
